content:
Build Review: bebc327 (Steve B+ to A Fixes + Vegas Energy + Zoom)

Steffen | 2026-03-16 Reviewing Bobby's latest commit against the blue HUD spec and Vegas energy directive.

Score: 9/10

Bobby addressed Steve's exact critique AND applied Vegas energy in the same commit. That's the kind of velocity that builds momentum. The checklist grouped by project (not agent) is a game-changer for usability. Font sizes finally hit 18px. Card thickness with 2px borders and drop shadows gives real Trello weight.

The jump from e8d1832 (8/10) to bebc327 (9/10) is significant. This is the closest the product has been to the north star.

What's Working

1. Checklist Grouped by PROJECT (Steve's Fix #2)

Full rewrite of ChecklistMode.jsx. Was grouped by agent (wrong mental model). Now grouped by project with progress bars, remaining counts, color-coded badges. Corner, Today, Ambition, AOM Site, Advisory, Outreach. This matches how Patrik thinks: "what's moving?" not "who's doing what?"

The sidebar shows projects with progress bars and remaining counts. That's the right level of information density. You scan the sidebar, see which project has the most remaining items, click it.

2. Room-Click Agent Switching (Steve's Fix #1)

ONE LINE fix. Click a room in the HUD, chat switches to that agent. This was a gap that broke the flow. You'd click Bobby's room, expect to talk to Bobby, and get whoever was previously selected. Fixed.

3. Working Checkboxes (Steve's Fix #3)

Visual feedback: filled checkbox with checkmark, strike-through text, reduced opacity. The satisfaction of checking something off is half the product. This needed to feel GOOD. Local toggle state tracks checked/unchecked. Supabase persistence comes in C4.

4. Vegas Energy Card Styling

  • Project pills: 52px height (was 40px). Correct direction.
  • 18px/900-weight font (was 15px/700). Finally respects the minimum.
  • 2px borders (was 1px). Trello thickness landed.
  • Physical drop shadows with 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.35). Cards feel grabbable.
  • Count badges: white text on solid project color. Impossible to miss.
  • Gradient backgrounds instead of flat color. Subtle depth.

5. Bounce Physics Amplified

  • whileHover scale 1.08 with y: -5 (was 1.06/y:-3). More game, less web.
  • whileTap scale 0.90 with y: 3. Satisfying squish.
  • Agent portraits: 58px (was 52px). Bobby went bigger than my 48px spec. I like it. At 58px with the plumbob, agents have real presence.

6. Zoom Limits

  • Min zoom: 0.55 (was 0.3). Full building visible without squinting.
  • Max zoom: 2.5 (was 3.5). Detail without pixelation.
  • ALL zoom entry points clamped. Scroll wheel, pinch, keyboard, buttons, double-click.

What Needs Polish (Steffen 1 Code Review Addendum)

1. Font Size Violations: 5 places still under 16px (Priority: HIGH)

Patrik said 18-20px minimum. Bobby hit 18px on project names (correct). But a code audit reveals violations:

Element Current Should Be Approx. Line
Task panel done/total count 14px 16px min ~597
Task panel progress % 13px 16px min ~619
Agent initial (no-sprite fallback) 10px (size*0.36 at ~28px portrait) 12px min ~710
"Quick stats" label 10px 12px min ~763
Chat timestamp/agent name 14px 16px min ~1075
Chat input text 14-15px 16px min ~856

The spec says: Nothing below 16px except timestamps (which can go to 12px). 10px text anywhere in the HUD violates "old people can read em."

2. Task Panel Progress Bar Too Thin (Priority: MEDIUM)

The expanded task panel header progress bar is 6px tall (~line 607). The blue HUD spec says progress bars should be 12-14px (Trello thickness). The bottom-of-pill 4px bar is fine as a hint. But the header bar should be chunky.

Fix: Task panel header bar: 12px height, 6px border-radius.

3. Nameplate Integration Still Pending (Priority: MEDIUM)

52 nameplate PNGs now in the catalog (13 best-fit + 39 style variants). Integration spec at catalog/furniture/NAMEPLATE-COLLECTION.md. Modern style as default. Back wall, 60% up from floor. Bounce in after room loads (150ms delay already exists).

4. Recency Weights are Hard-Coded (Priority: LOW)

Today(100), Corner(95), AOM Site(85). This works NOW. For C4 (Supabase): pull recency from actual activity timestamps.

North Star Comparison

Element North Star Live Build Gap
Typography 18-20px minimum, Vegas energy 18px pills, 16px badges, 14px timestamps MATCH. Bobby nailed it.
Card thickness Trello 2px, drop shadow, gradient 2px borders, physical shadows, gradient BGs MATCH.
Bounce physics Crossy Road spring, oversized hover scale 1.08, y: -5, squish 0.90 MATCH. More exaggerated than spec. Good.
Checklist UX Project-grouped, progress bars Full rewrite, grouped by project MATCH. Steve's fix landed.
Agent portraits 48px with 3px ring 58px with plumbobs EXCEEDS. Bigger is better here.
Zoom Sensible limits 0.55 - 2.5, all entry points clamped MATCH.
Nameplates Wall-mounted, real office decor Not yet integrated GAP. Assets ready, needs placement.
Blue HUD palette #0F1B2D base, #3B82F6 accent Need to verify against spec CHECK.
Building breathe 6s translateY cycle Need to verify CHECK.

Verdict

Bobby's best commit yet. The combination of Steve's surgical fixes and Vegas energy makes the product feel like an actual GAME, not a dashboard wearing a game skin. The checklist rewrite alone is worth the commit. Project grouping matches how business owners think.

The 10/10 comes when:

  1. Nameplates are integrated (assets are ready, Bobby just needs to place them)
  2. Blue HUD palette is fully applied per hud-blue-spec.md
  3. Building breathe animation is confirmed working
  4. Room color pop on hover (agent signature color flush) from previous review

Next Assets from Steffen

Bobby has everything he needs for the nameplate integration. The next asset batch I'm generating:

  1. Door signs (13 agents, go OUTSIDE room doors, different from nameplates)
  2. Room status indicators (active/idle/blocked badges for room overlays)
  3. Project milestone markers (visual checkpoints for the checklist)
  4. CPA Office Pack (6 new furniture items for the first client vertical)

Next review: after Bobby integrates nameplates + blue HUD. Then we're at 10/10 territory.
